welcomeTxt:
Welcome to HypernetOS v2.0!

This is a highly advanced, fully modular alchemical operating system running inside RPG Maker MZ.

Here, you can run multiple applications simultaneously, configure custom options inside the Control Panel, view hardware specifications that mirror your party's stats, and manage text files in a virtual directory.

Double-click a text file to launch Notepad!
